question: 2017 年每个月的订单量
generated_sql: SELECT to_char(v_o_orders.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT v_o_orders.order_id) AS order_cnt FROM v_o_orders WHERE v_o_orders.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND v_o_orders.order_purchase_timestamp >= %(start_ts)s AND v_o_orders.order_purchase_timestamp < %(end_ts)s GROUP BY to_char(v_o_orders.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month ASC LIMIT 100
